symptom: H 300 alarm 47 vacuum not reached, seals not holding vacuum on 200 micron film, cycle slow
resolution_cause: Seal bar PTFE cover torn, seam not gas tight
resolution_action: Replaced seal bar and PTFE cover, ran three empty cycles, leak test passed

symptom: alarm 47 on H300 every cycle after film change, vacuum drops during dwell, seams leak at corners
resolution_cause: Seal bar PTFE cover worn through at one end
resolution_action: Fitted new seal bar, checked pressure equalising bolts, corners sealed

symptom: H 300 vacuum not reached, machine hisses at chamber, cycle time creeping up over weeks
resolution_action: Replaced chamber gasket profile, 3.4 m, evacuation back to 6 s

symptom: alarm 47 and poor vacuum, pump runs hot, cannot get below 40 mbar
resolution_cause: Vacuum pump vane set worn beyond limit
resolution_action: Replaced vane set and pump gasket kit, bedded in 20 minutes, ultimate pressure 8 mbar

symptom: alarm 44 seal temperature deviation repeats after thermocouple replacement, seam cold on left side
resolution_cause: Cartridge heater aged, resistance above 96 ohm
resolution_action: Replaced cartridge heater 230 V 400 W, temperature stable

symptom: alarm 49 seal bar wear limit, groove visible on bar, seams weak across full width
resolution_cause: Seal bar worn beyond 0.3 mm groove limit
resolution_action: Replaced seal bar, adjusted dwell from 1.8 to 2.0 s for heavier film

symptom: R245 alarm 22 film slip, print registration drifting, worse at high line speed
resolution_cause: Gripper springs lost force after high cycle count
resolution_action: Replaced gripper springs both sides, reset chain tension to 8 mm deflection

symptom: registration drift increasing with line speed, alarm 22 intermittent, no mechanical noise
resolution_action: Replaced encoder coupling, drift eliminated, no alarm in 8 h run

symptom: web forming bridging between cavities on same position every cycle, film looks cold there
resolution_action: Replaced forming heater element 2.5 kW, forming clean

symptom: alarm 27 trim extraction blocked, film bunching at chain, product is flour coated
resolution_cause: Trim extraction duct blocked with product dust
resolution_action: Cleared duct, agreed shift-start cleaning with customer

symptom: T700 alarm 31 tray jam at infeed only on 227x178 format, trays skew entering seal station
resolution_cause: Worn infeed guide rail, trays skewing
resolution_action: Replaced guide rail, checked parallelism, no jam in 12 h

symptom: residual oxygen 3.2 percent on red meat, gas pressure correct, seals visually good
resolution_action: Replaced O-ring set, residual oxygen down to 0.4 percent

symptom: thin band visible across seal on 190x140 trays only, other format runs clean
resolution_action: Replaced seal insert 190x140, seal even across full width

symptom: alarm 47 but gauge shows good vacuum, seams poor, sensor reading differs from reference gauge
resolution_action: Calibrated sensor against reference gauge, no parts required

symptom: tray jam alarm 31 on both formats after customer changed tray supplier, trays slightly warped
resolution_cause: Customer tray dimensional variance, not a machine fault
resolution_action: Adjusted infeed guides to tolerance, advised customer on tray specification
